The area of a regular hexagon with side length 7 cm is **(147√3)/2 cm² ≈ 127.31 cm²**.

I ran the query on Wolfram|Alpha (submitted through the homepage input, then loaded the results page at `wolframalpha.com/input?i=area+of+a+regular+hexagon+with+side+length+7+cm`). The "Result" pod shows `(147 sqrt(3))/2 cm^2 ≈ 127.306 cm^2`, which matches the formula A = (3√3/2)·s² with s = 7.
